<div class="section-intro">
This section is a curated discovery layer for scientific software that has a verifiable public repository and sufficient documentation to support external use or technical review. Source code, issues, releases, tests, manuals, and development history remain in their canonical GitHub repositories.
</div>

Repository classification comes from the academic-profile catalogue, but **classification alone is not enough for inclusion here**. A repository must also pass a website-level readiness audit. Experimental applications are labelled explicitly and are not presented as official monitoring or management products.

{{< include _generated.md >}}

## Catalogue policy

The authoritative repository inventory is maintained in [`qselmer/qselmer`](https://github.com/qselmer/qselmer). This website synchronizes only the curated software subset into `assets/data/software.json`. Editorial inclusion rules are stored in `software/registry.json`; generated presentation content must not be edited by hand.

Repositories that are incomplete, undocumented, private, concept-stage, or not yet defensibly classified remain outside the primary software catalogue until their own repository audit is complete.
